round1: Nathan took the first round with 24 points, the only one to nail both St. Louis in six and San Jose in seven. Rookie Theodore started with 13 and Jake finished at the bottom with 5. Benedict picked all eight series in seven games, and Kiersten was the only one to nail the Islanders in four.
round2: Nathan picked every winning team and scored 22 to stretch the lead. Nickall picked the wrong team in all four series for a round of zero, his eighth zero-point round ever. Derrick jumped from 12th to 5th, while Theodore fell from 3rd to 10th.
round3: Nathan was the only one to nail St. Louis in six and scored 15 while nobody else got above 7. Jake scored zero and sat at 13 points total.
round4: Benedict, Jaclyn, Jake and Nathan all took Boston in seven for 5, the game count being the only thing they got right. Derrick, Jamie, Nickall, Robin and Stephanie took St. Louis for 4. Ryan picked the wrong Cup winner for the fifth year in a row.
overall: Nathan won his fourth title with 66 points, the highest winning score in pool history (previous best 63) and 31 clear of second, despite picking the wrong Cup winner for the fourth year in a row. Ryan went from champion to 18 points and has now picked the wrong Cup winner five years straight. Marc finished last for the second time, Jamie went from 11th to 2nd, and Derrick climbed from 12th after Round 1 to 4th.
